title: Renewable Energy & Grid Infrastructure Lead
description: Engineers solar/wind renewable power installations, smart grid integration, substation designs, and sustainable energy projects.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead utility-scale renewable energy projects, smart power grid connectivity, and high-voltage electrical substation engineering.

### Key Responsibilities
- Design solar PV plants, wind farms, and battery energy storage system (BESS) interconnects.
- Conduct power system studies, load flow analysis, and grid compliance assessments.
- Coordinate EPC contractors, environmental regulators, and power distribution authorities.

### Requirements
- B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, or Power Engineering.
- 6+ years of experience in solar/wind renewable projects and grid infrastructure.
